name: Banh mi bo nuong
summary: Bánh mì bò nướng is a baguette with marinated grilled beef, herbs, and cucumber. Vietnam Airlines says the beef is fragrant, soft, and sweet, names a sauce it does not describe, and prints 25,000–40,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Airlines names Nguyễn Thái Học.
howToEat: Eat it in the hand. The sauce ingredients were not printed.
The hour is Check on arrival.
